VERDICT: CONCUR on the rendered scope of PR 500 under Albert's A-2026-10-23-002 evidence split, for the exact candidate page SHA-256 e5696e60b60faef5f456647ff2a153b939871acb895a6671d3d95a718d2ad55a at PR head f15039d5103dcbe0da86f13a1f7284def8948f3b. This is the independent rendered review A002 required; it is separate from my J-2026-10-23-007 registration-source review (finished_pixels false there, unchanged) and from my J-2026-10-23-008 gate-change concurrence.

Scope: rendered. finished_pixels: true. I personally viewed all five capture images named below; this record asserts rendered pixels because I actually inspected them, not from collector assertion. finished_behavior: true, supported by the collector's recorded interaction results in observations.json plus my pixel corroboration of the resulting dialog states (open dialogs with the full action row rendered at both viewports).

Hash verification I performed myself: observations.json SHA-256 a045105bbd36638b211a5b5324d54ad4f481b1106b343404b614a81b89eddd27, matching the stated collector record hash. Each capture file's SHA-256 matches the value recorded for it in observations.json: desktop-commission-dialog.png 4cb6858efa43231d5ddf5153df2ecb70a18d34e6495579139a24f85800542afb; desktop-samuel-smith-dialog.png b1586669edc8abb5aa581895065eea0f8acd05cd1c46de744caf48eda35be039; phone-commission-dialog.png 1e1940a3e6508293413dd6e77821652a30a6e7138f1bd55c67c7fe0bfdef0fa3; phone-commission-dialog-actions.png 339bf013e6aa2acecbb599fc6cde653bae5649075d311bd8ffde0a4a68ccd257; phone-samuel-smith-dialog.png e5d5f91638e2c99d9d6878da5428445f6821eb210dadb00d58b6dae04aeed30d. Served page SHA-256 e5696e60b60faef5f456647ff2a153b939871acb895a6671d3d95a718d2ad55a and missionary-details.js SHA-256 55bb051609d1bb1b1793eb44539d812e71b1c62f789617c0f5b36c1b1a47f17a; I spot-checked the workspace candidate tree and confirmed missionary.html and missionary-details.js hash to exactly those values, that the page carries 13 data-missionary-detail triggers, and that the dialog action row carries the X (aria-label 'Close detail window'), Continue Lesson, and Close controls, each bearing data-missionary-detail-close.

What the pixels show: Desktop 1440x1000 commission capture: dialog titled 'The Savior Sends His Apostles' under 'CHRIST'S COMMISSION', X at top right, action row 'Read Matthew 28', 'View Full-Size Image', 'Continue Lesson', and the Close pill fully visible and in bounds beside Continue Lesson; layout and text read correctly. Desktop Samuel Smith (second trigger) capture: 'Samuel Smith Carries the Message' dialog with Continue Lesson and the Close pill both fully in bounds. Phone captures are Chromium device emulation at 390x844 with touch, honestly labeled as emulation and not a physical phone: the unscrolled commission capture shows the title, X, and the stacked action buttons beginning; the scrolled phone-commission-dialog-actions capture shows the full action stack 'Read Matthew 28', 'View Full-Size Image', 'Continue Lesson', 'Close', every pill full width, readable, and in bounds; the phone Samuel Smith capture shows the same correct dialog layout. The recorded interaction results in observations.json (13 triggers at both viewports; Close pill present and in bounds; pill, X, and Continue Lesson each close the dialog; keyboard Enter on the pill closes; focus returns to the trigger; second trigger behaves the same; no uncaught page errors) are consistent with everything the captures show.

Scope limits: this concurrence covers rendered pixels and rendered behavior of the Close pill change only, at the candidate hashes above. The phone evidence is viewport emulation, not a physical device. The two resource-load notes per viewport in observations.json (one external fetch tunnel failure, one 404 identified as favicon) are not page script errors and do not affect this scope. I did not run GitHub CI. Artwork anatomy, including the separate commission hand repair task, is outside this review. Any change to the page, details script, or capture bytes invalidates this concurrence.
subject: PR500 rendered review CONCUR (A002 rendered scope): Merlin-collected captures hash-verified and personally viewed; Close pill visible and in bounds on desktop and phone emulation
